# Listing 40: Computer als Melodiengenerator (computer as melody generator)
# From the Kosmos CP1 manual, section 2.13, pages 100-102; read from the scanned listing for this emulator.
#
# The tune is a list of pairs: pitch, then length in eighth notes. Pitch is the Port 2 line that is switched on:
# line 1 = c, 2 = d, 3 = e, 4 = f, 5 = g, 6 = a, 7 = h (b), 8 = c' (values 1, 2, 4, ... 128); 0 = pause; 0,0 = end.
# Cell 031: 1 = repeat. Cell 032: where the tune starts - 033 is "Stille Nacht" (the manual's test melody),
# 045 is "If I had a hammer". Change cell 032 to pick the other one.

001 ako 04.001
002 abs 06.029
003 ako 04.000
004 abs 06.028
005 lda 05.032
006 abs 06.030
007 lia 19.030
008 p2a 18.000
009 lda 05.030
010 add 07.029
011 abs 06.030
012 lia 19.030
013 vgl 10.028
014 spb 11.024
015 vzg 03.100
016 sub 08.029
017 vgr 12.028
018 spb 11.015
019 p2a 18.000
020 vzg 03.020
021 lda 05.030
022 add 07.029
023 spu 09.006

025 vgl 10.029
026 spb 11.003
